info.name: Sanad Admin — Care Homes
info.description: Care Homes operational endpoints only. CareHomesOperationalAdmin allows SuperAdmin and SupportAdmin; ContentAdmin is denied. Uses the existing Admin environment accessToken.

item.name: 01. Check-in dispute operations
item.description: Source-authored HC-034 room/bed assignment, actual facility check-in/out, Family confirmation, Family-submitted dispute, owner operational readback, and Admin dispute resolution. Requires an accepted booking and disposable fixture IDs. Check-out without Family confirmation opens a case immediately; a Family dispute requires a booking owned by that Family with facility check-in recorded. These examples are authored, not runtime evidence.

request.description: CareHomesOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin only; ContentAdmin is denied). Lists cases newest first. Each case carries the stored residentArabicName/residentEnglishName snapshots and the original booking originalBookingTotalAmount in originalBookingCurrency (current fixed Care Home currency convention, EGP; the booking does not persist a currency). List-only enrichment; resolve and Family submission shapes are unchanged. Provide an authorized admin token before running.

CareHomesOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin only; ContentAdmin is denied). Evidence, reason and a UTC effective check-in are required. Missing case is 404 CareHomes.CheckInDispute.NotFound; repeated/invalid resolution is 409 CareHomes.CheckInDispute.InvalidState. Supply an authorized admin token before running.

item.name: 02. Refund recovery
item.description: Requires separate disposable bookings in the indicated states. Family cancellation before recorded check-in refunds totalAmount; after recorded check-in it refunds 50%. Owner cancellation of an accepted stay refunds the full amount. Admin recovery requires a failed or externally completed refund. No requests reset or seed the database.

request.description: Only a persisted failed refund is retryable. Local runtime requires a disposable failed-refund fixture; no provider call outside the Development stub is authorized.
Records completion only; this endpoint does not call Paymob. SuperAdmin/SupportAdmin only.

item.name: 03. Facility application review
item.description: SuperAdmin/SupportAdmin only. ContentAdmin must receive 403. Requests are authored against the current controller contract and require an existing submitted disposable application; no Bruno execution is claimed.

request.description: Returns page/pageSize/totalCount/items. Each item carries ownerArabicName/ownerEnglishName (nullable account display names; null when the identity is missing or anonymized; no phone). Invalid paging or status returns 400 CareHomes.Admin.InvalidQuery.

Returns ownerArabicName/ownerEnglishName, revisions, document metadata and review history without private storage keys. Each revision carries ordered media metadata (id, kind, position, contentType, length, uri pointing at the Admin media file route). Each history entry carries actorArabicName/actorEnglishName and actorCurrentRoles (current account roles at read time, not historical roles; nulls when the identity is missing or anonymized). Unknown IDs return 404 CareHomes.Admin.ApplicationNotFound.
Streams private content only for PendingReview/Approved/Suspended applications. Draft/correction returns CareHomes.Admin.PrivateDocumentUnavailable.
Explicit confirmation is required for a verified document with no expiry. Stale version returns 409 CareHomes.Admin.Conflict.
Reasoned rejection returns the updated detail. Invalid state returns 400 CareHomes.Admin.InvalidOperation.
Action enum: 1 Approved, 2 Rejected, 3 CorrectionsRequested, 4 Suspended, 5 Reactivated. Supply a reason for rejection, correction, or suspension.

item.name: Read private facility media for review

request.description: Private facility media for operational review. Requires CareHomesOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin); ContentAdmin is denied. Returns media bytes or 404 for unknown/unassociated media.

item.name: 04. Inventory inspection
item.description: SuperAdmin/SupportAdmin only under CareHomesOperationalAdmin. ContentAdmin, owners, Family accounts and anonymous callers are denied. Requests are authored from the current source contract; the additive migration awaits fresh exact-target authorization and no Bruno execution is claimed for this delta.

item.name: Get care-home inventory

request.description: CareHomesOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin/SupportAdmin). Returns 200 with the CareHomeInventoryDto for any facility; 404 for an unknown facility.

item.description: Returns room types, rooms, beds, maintenance and inventory version. Unknown facility returns 404 CareHomes.Inventory.NotFound.

item.name: Get care-home availability

request.description: CareHomesOperationalAdmin. POST with startDate/endDate; returns 200 with an array of CareHomeAvailability rows. This is a POST, not a GET.

item.description: Returns derived room-type availability. Dates are Egypt-local calendar dates; end must be after start. Archived assets, maintenance and supplied active occupancy are excluded. The current occupancy provider is empty until HC-TASK-032/034.

item.name: 05. Payout ledger
item.description: HC-TASK-038. PayoutOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin/FinanceAdmin) only. A bank transfer must already have been performed outside Sanad; these requests only record/read ledger state and never initiate provider transfers. Use only an authorized disposable fixture. The migration is applied in the authorized disposable fixture; no new Bruno run is claimed for this authorization change.

request.description: Returns checked-out paid/refunded bookings, remaining payable, effective Finance payout-fee rate, net amount, recorded transfer metadata, and outstanding facility debt. An eligible payable requires an effective Finance rule; absent configuration fails closed.

STATE-CHANGING: call only after the external bank transfer is complete. One payout per completed eligible stay; gross, percentage fee, net, Finance rule version, evidence/reference, actor and time are snapshotted.

STATE-CHANGING: records a confirmed external refund/reversal for reconciliation; it does not issue the refund. Facility debt is proportional to the recorded net payout for the refunded share. Reference is the idempotency key.

item.name: 06. License expiry view
item.description: Read-only, paginated operational Admin view. No fixture or database state changes are required.

request.description: CareHomesOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin only; ContentAdmin, owners, Family and anonymous callers are denied). through is a required inclusive Cairo-local YYYY-MM-DD cutoff. Includes expired and upcoming licenses through that date, sorted by expiry then facility ID. Only latest verified finite-expiry operating license on approved revision qualifies. Invalid date/paging returns 400 CareHomes.Admin.InvalidQuery.

item.name: 07. Booking inspection
item.description: Read-only operational booking register and detail. Requires CareHomesOperationalAdmin; no fixture or database mutation is performed.

request.description: All filters except page/pageSize are optional. Page size is 1–100. State filters use numeric enum values. Stay dates are inclusive and select overlapping stays. Search matches an exact booking GUID or merchant reference. Results order newest first then booking ID. The response contains page, pageSize, totalCount and items; each row also carries the persisted charge taxAmount and the nullable extensionOfBookingId (null for a base booking, the extended segment's booking ID for an extension row). Invalid query returns 400 CareHomes.Admin.InvalidQuery. Authenticated runtime evidence is not claimed by this authored request.

Returns persisted booking/charge/payment/refund/check-in/out facts and assignment/dispute history. Does not expose clinical intake, care notes, contact fields, or payment credentials. Unknown booking returns 404 CareHomes.Bookings.NotFound. Authenticated runtime evidence is not claimed by this authored request.

item.name: 08. Visit requests
item.description: Read-only operational register and detail for care-home visit requests, under CareHomesOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin only; ContentAdmin, owners, Family and anonymous callers are denied). No Admin scheduling, approval, rejection, cancellation or override route exists; no fixture or database mutation is performed. Rows additionally carry the facility's approved display name (facilityName, English preferred with an Arabic fallback) and the family's name (familyName) — both nullable, each resolved in one batched lookup per page. These examples are authored, not runtime evidence.

request.description: Read-only. facilityId, status and the scheduled from/to window are optional. from/to are inclusive UTC days matched as overlap against the scheduled window (a visit matches when endsAtUtc is after the start of from and startsAtUtc is before the end of to). Paging is clamped, never an error: page is at least 1 and pageSize defaults to 25 and is capped at 100. Only an empty facilityId, an undefined status or an inverted window (to before from) returns 400 CareHomes.Admin.InvalidQuery. Results order newest first by startsAtUtc then visitId. The response contains page, pageSize, totalCount and items; each item carries visitId, facilityId, facilityName (the approved profile revision's English name with an Arabic fallback, nullable), familyId, familyName (the Families aggregate's stored name, nullable), nullable elderlyId, kind (1 Prospective, 2 Resident), status (1 Pending, 2 Approved, 3 Rejected, 4 FamilyCancelled, 5 FacilityCancelled, 6 Expired, 7 ReschedulePending, 8 Rescheduled), startsAtUtc, endsAtUtc, nullable rescheduleOfVisitId, the recorded decision facts (decidedByUserId, decidedOnUtc, decisionReason) and cancellation facts (cancelledByUserId, cancelledOnUtc, cancellationReason), and createdOnUtc. Visitor name and phone, visitorCount, the requesting familyUserId, decisionExpiresOnUtc and version are never returned.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalCount'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('page'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('pageSize'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('items').that.is.an('array'); pm.expect(body.items.length).to.be.at.most(100); if (body.items.length > 0) { pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('visitId'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('status'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('facilityName'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('familyName'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.to.include('visitorPhone'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.to.include('visitorName'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.to.include('visitorCount'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.to.include('decisionExpiresOnUtc'); } }

request.description: Read-only. Returns the list fields (including nullable facilityName and familyName) plus updatedOnUtc, read from the stored row only. Visitor name and phone, visitorCount, the requesting familyUserId, decisionExpiresOnUtc and version are never returned, and no event history or timeline is derived. Unknown or empty visit ids return 404 CareHomes.Visits.NotFound. Set careHomeVisitId from a list item first.
